_comment: Machine-readable provenance for everything that can reach a production build.
Enforced by tools/asset_gate.py; see docs/ASSET_POLICY.md for the rules.
Fail-closed: a production file with no entry here, an unrecognised
commercial_status, a dependency licence that forbids commercial use, or a
sha256 that no longer matches the bytes on disk all block the build.
Only a human may set commercial_status to 'cleared' -- see the promote command.
